title: Extended Kalman Filter
text: Estimate states of discrete-time nonlinear system using extended Kalman filter, 6 inputs, 2 outputs, {Initial covariance} sets State estimation error covariance; {Function} sets the state transition, {Jacobian}, {Process noise}, {Covariance} sets the time-invariant process noise covariance, {Time-varying}, {Initial state}, {Measurement noise}, {Enable measurement wrapping}, {Add Enable Port} enables correction of estimated states only when measured data, {Use the current measurements to improve state estimates} sets the between corrected or predicted state, {Output state estimation error covariance}, {Data type}, {Sample time} sets the block sample time, {Enable multirate operation} enables specification of different sample times for state transition and measurement and {Sample times} sets the state transition and measurement function sample times positive. Values come from the instance.
